accessNotes: The old /guidelines/charts/ URL now redirects to the SLDS 2 zeroheight site, which is JS-rendered and blocked to web_fetch; web.archive.org was temporarily offline. The full SLDS 2 'Patterns / Data visualization / Charts' page was read by rendering it in a headless browser (text + chart image URLs). The Data Visualization overview page redirected to the cover and was not read. The SLDS GitHub repo contains no chart-specific tokens; the ui-analytics token file only gives a system font stack and generic sizes. Typography sizes, gridline colours and axis specs are therefore not stated and are left null except where visible in example images.
summary: Enterprise CRM product-UI chart guidance (Salesforce/Tableau CRM charting library): clean white canvases, light grey gridlines, rounded sans labels, and a set of six-colour named palettes (Default, Color Safe, Light, Dark, Bluegrass, Sunrise, Water, Watermelon). The guide is chart-selection oriented (comparison, trending, relationship, composition, distribution, metric, location, pipeline) with Do/Don't rules such as zero baselines, ≤4 lines, 2–5 pie slices and single colour per measure.

colors.categoricalNotes: This is the 'Default Palette' (midtone hues from around the colour wheel). Other selectable themes: Color Safe (accessible, WCAG 2.0) #529EE0, #D9A6C2, #08916D, #F59B00, #006699, #F0E442; Light #3296ED, #77B9F2, #9D53F2, #C398F5, #26ABA4, #4ED4CD; Dark #0E70C7, #3296ED, #7719E3, #9D53F2, #067D77, #26ABA4. Non-default themes pair hues roughly 180° apart. Five colours recommended as a practical maximum (short-term memory). Same metric = same colour across all bars/charts; different categories in donut/treemap get distinct hues (not shades). Note: the guide's example images actually use the Light palette (#3296ED, #77B9F2, #9D53F2).
colors.notes: Sequential listed is the 'Water' palette. Other ramp-like themes: Bluegrass #C7F296, #94E7A8, #51D2BB, #27AAB0, #116985, #053661; Sunrise #F5DE98, #F5C062, #F59623, #CE6716, #762F3D, #300561; Watermelon #F598A7, #F56580, #F4284E, #C11C2F, #5C3F22, #0A611B. Continuous values: one hue or a gradient of one hue. Red=bad / green=good metaphor acceptable only within a single culture. Background white is from example images.

typography.family: Salesforce Sans (as seen in example images); analytics token stack is system UI
typography.fallback: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

axisTitle.placement: rotated beside axis, very light grey (example dual-axis line chart)

typography.notes: ui-analytics tokens: font sizes 0.625rem, 0.75rem, 0.875rem, 1rem, 1.125rem, 1.25rem, 1.5rem; weights 300/400/700. Example images: grey-blue axis tick labels, dark navy category labels, medium grey legend text. Charts are shown without in-image titles (titles are page captions such as 'Bar Chart: Sales by Account').

structure.gridlines: Light grey solid gridlines perpendicular to the value axis only (vertical for horizontal bars, horizontal for line/column charts), as seen in examples.
structure.axisLine: No visible axis lines in examples; faint baseline only.
structure.zeroLine: Zero baseline required (bars and scatter axes must start at 0) but not visually emphasised.
structure.yAxisPlacement: left (secondary measure on right for dual-measure line chart)
structure.yAxisTitle: rotated, pale grey, outside tick labels (dual-axis example)
structure.frame: none in examples (charts live inside Lightning cards in product)
structure.notes: Horizontal-bar example places value-axis labels along the TOP of the chart.

legend.title: not shown
legend.notes: Legend row of filled circles + label beneath the plot in both stacked bar and donut examples.

marks.bars: Square-cornered bars with small gaps (~10-15% of band); stacked segments abut with no separator; ordinal data sorted ascending or descending; single colour for one measure.
marks.lines: Thick (~4px) lines, straight segments, no point markers; up to four lines; optional pale translucent fill underneath each line.
marks.areas: Low-opacity tinted fill of the line colour (pale lilac / pale blue) beneath lines.
marks.points: Dot plots / scatter: circles with size and colour/intensity as 3rd/4th measures.
marks.pies: 2–5 values; descending order starting at 12 o'clock moving clockwise; example is a thin-ring donut with no labels on the ring and circle-swatch legend below.
marks.notes: Treemaps sorted by size (larger at left/bottom). Gauges (flat, polar, ratings) should include a target/average reference point.

labels.numberFormat: Abbreviated currency on axes ($10M, $5M); plain integers (0, 200, 400).
labels.dates: Short month names (Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr).
labels.notes: Always pair colour with symbols or text.

furniture.title: Chart titles in the guide are captions of the form '<Chart type>: <Measure> by <Dimension>' (e.g. 'Bar Chart: Sales by Account'); no headline-style titles.
furniture.other: Charts sit within product UI (Lightning cards/dashboards).

annotations: Use colour and size to highlight patterns and identify outliers; outliers should be identified by colour variation.
interaction: Not covered on the Charts page; users can select colour themes from the Salesforce charting library.
accessibility: Color Safe theme passes WCAG 2.0 contrast; always use symbols or text in addition to colour; prefer colour-safe themes.

discouraged: line charts with >4 series or mixed measures
chartTypes.notes: Bar chart described as 'the workhorse of analytics'.

distinctiveRules.rule: Default categorical palette is #52B7D8, #E16032, #FFB03B, #54A77B, #4FD2D2, #E287B2 (six midtone hues around the wheel).
Bars and scatter axes always start at zero.
distinctiveRules.quote: Don't set the baseline to any number other than zero.

distinctiveRules.rule: One colour for all bars of the same measure; no decorative colouring.
distinctiveRules.quote: Do use a single color to represent all values compared against the same measure.

distinctiveRules.rule: Line charts carry at most four series.
distinctiveRules.quote: Do use a line chart to represent data with four or fewer related values.

distinctiveRules.rule: Pie/donut: 2–5 slices, descending, starting at 12 o'clock clockwise.
distinctiveRules.quote: Do show data in descending order, starting at the 12 o'clock point and moving clockwise.

distinctiveRules.rule: Donut/treemap categories use distinct hues, never shades of one hue; continuous values use one hue or its gradient.
distinctiveRules.quote: Do not use the shades of the same color on a donut or tree-map.

distinctiveRules.rule: Limit to five colours as a practical maximum.
distinctiveRules.quote: making five a good maximum for color choices

distinctiveRules.rule: Legend is a centred row of filled circle swatches beneath the chart.
distinctiveRules.quote: Observed in stacked bar and donut example images.

distinctiveRules.rule: Gridlines only along the value axis, light grey; no axis lines or tick marks.
Lines are thick (~4px) without markers, with a pale translucent area fill beneath.
Ordinal data shown in ascending or descending order; treemap parents sorted by size, larger at left/bottom.
distinctiveRules.quote: Do sort parent rectangles by size (most commonly with larger ones at the left and/or bottom of the chart).

distinctiveRules.rule: Gauges/ratings must include a reference point (target or average).
distinctiveRules.quote: Do add context with a reference point representing target or average value.

distinctiveRules.rule: Selectable accessible 'Color Safe' theme: #529EE0, #D9A6C2, #08916D, #F59B00, #006699, #F0E442; colour always paired with symbols or text.
distinctiveRules.quote: When using color to distinguish chart elements, always use symbols or text as well.

referenceImages.describes: Stacked horizontal bar chart 'Sales by Account and Product' on white. Value-axis labels 0/200/400/600 in light grey-blue across the TOP; light grey vertical gridlines; no axis lines or ticks. Dark navy category labels 'Account A–E' left. Square-cornered bars, small gaps, segments in #3296ED-like blue, light blue (#77B9F2-ish) and purple (#9D53F2-ish). Bottom-centred legend with filled circles 'Product A/B/C'. No title, source or logo in image.

Dual-axis line chart: thick purple and blue lines with no markers, each with a pale translucent fill (lilac / periwinkle) to baseline. Horizontal light grey gridlines only; left ticks $0–$50M and right ticks $0–$5M in medium grey; rotated very pale grey axis titles 'Sales' (left) and 'Profit' (right). x labels Jan/Feb/Mar/Apr. No axis lines, ticks, legend or title.

Thin-ring donut (large hole) with three segments blue, light blue, purple starting at 12 o'clock going clockwise; no slice gaps or labels on ring. Centred legend below with filled circles and grey labels 'Email', 'Call', 'Text'.
